description: Eight clipped right down to smooth cream stubble, slim and leggy as young goats, none wider than its own head, thick woolly caps on their heads and woolly cuffs at their ankles, backs level with the second hurdle rail.
Ten shorn to velvet-smooth cream stubble, bald-bodied and goat-slim, woolly hats and woolly socks intact, ears out sideways, packed loosely together, no back clearing the top hurdle rail.
Nine clipped bare to ivory stubble, leggy and narrow as young goats, woolly caps and ankle cuffs only, standing loose on the swept plank floor, backs well below the shed doorway's mid-height.
Eight smooth-bodied cream-stubble sheep, slim as greyhounds, woolly head-caps and cuffed ankles, black-faced above bare ivory necks, ears wide and level, none as broad as the hurdle post beside them.

Ten clipped to close cream stubble, tan-cheeked heads above bald-bodied necks, woolly cuffs at every ankle, goat-leggy and narrow, their backs sitting well below the second hurdle rail, chewing steadily.

Eight stubbly cream-bodied sheep, soot-grey about the muzzle, bald and slim as young goats, woolly caps and cuffed ankles only, loose on the swept plank floor, none taller than the bottom half of the shed door.

Eleven clipped bare, ivory-smooth and goat-slim, woolly head-caps sitting thick above bared necks, speckle-nosed, ears sideways, scattered loosely across the pen, backs all below the second hurdle rail.
A dozen in full coat, grown deep and dense and dusty at the tips, parting down the spine, round as barrels, legs looking improbably short beneath them, backs level with the top hurdle rail.

Twenty in full coat packed shoulder to shoulder, oatmeal-coloured and barrel-round, dusty-tipped wool parting down every spine, legs hidden entirely, a solid uneven mass that fills the pen's full width.

Fifteen woolly sheep in full deep coat, black-faced and barrel-round, shoulder to shoulder in the holding pen, their combined bulk filling less of the shed than the doorway is wide, chewing in unison.

Eighteen in full coat, tan-cheeked and barrel-round, scattered loose across the yard, dusty-tipped wool parting down every spine, legs barely visible, their backs level with the top of the yard gate's lower rail.

Fourteen broad cream-woolled sheep, dense coats grown out so thick the animals read as rounded blocks with heads attached, legs improbably short, packed close, their backs just clearing the second hurdle rail.

Four stubbly goat-slim bodies stand among ten barrel-round woolly ones fully twice their width, every bare back sitting below the second hurdle rail that the woolly shoulders clear, both groups chewing steadily.

Three clipped-bare cream-stubble sheep beside nine barrel-round woolly ones, the bare bodies less than half the woolly width, the woolly ones round as buckets, the bare ones narrow as the hurdle post, ears spread wide.

Six shorn to ivory stubble, goat-slim, stand among eight barrel-round full-coated sheep on the swept plank floor, the woolly bodies twice as wide, the bare ones leggy and narrow beside them, all backs below the shed doorway's midpoint.

Five velvet-smooth cream-stubble sheep among eleven woolly barrel-round ones, the woolly bodies twice the bare width, both groups apparently aware of it, woolly caps and ankle cuffs on the bare ones, ears out flat.

Four bald-bodied goat-slim sheep, black-faced above cream stubble necks, stand beside eight full-coated ones round as barrels and twice their width, no bare back clearing the second hurdle rail, no woolly one below it.

Three clipped-bare speckle-nosed ones stand among a dozen thick-coated woolly ones in the open yard, the woolly bodies twice as wide as the bare, the gate’s lower rail clearing every bare back easily.

Five shorn to smooth cream stubble, slim as young goats, beside seven barrel-round woolly ones with dusty-tipped coats parting down the spine, the woolly width double the bare, both groups chewing and watching.

Six stubbly cream-bodied sheep, soot-grey muzzles, narrow as hurdle posts, stand among nine dense full-coated barrel-round ones on the swept plank floor, the woolly ones twice as broad, all backs below the shed doorway midpoint.

Four bald-bodied ivory-smooth sheep among twelve thick woolly ones, the woolly bodies twice the bare width, woolly caps and ankle cuffs on the bare ones, oatmeal-coloured coats on the woolly, both sides apparently measuring each other.

Three clipped-bare tan-cheeked sheep, goat-slim, woolly cuffs at the ankles, stand beside ten barrel-round woolly ones fully twice their width, all backs at or below the second hurdle rail, chewing in steady unison.
The whole pen of sixteen swings round to face the same direction at once, eight woolly and eight bare, a single uneven wave of heads all turning together, backs at the second hurdle rail.

Twenty or so packed shoulder to shoulder and shoving gently, a dense uneven mob of woolly barrel-round sheep, their combined weight pressing the hurdle, backs clearing the second rail, legs invisible beneath them.

One broad oatmeal-woolled sheep has its head through the hurdle, standing apart from fourteen others massed behind it, its back level with the second rail, the mob pressing loosely at the rear of the pen.
